title: Milton Keynes City Council – Milton Keynes AI (MKAI) Festival
summary: Milton Keynes offered a practical AI workshop and interactive demonstrations in 2024. Better understanding, confidence, and feedback remain intended benefits without measured changes.
account: The festival's program included Code For Her's October 29, 2024 workshop, with sessions for participants to use and build AI on their own laptops. The Open University confirms that this workshop was part of the festival. The Smart City Experience Centre opened on November 1 and offered interactive AI applications and robots, including Pepper for visitor information and infotainment. The host describes intended improvements in public understanding and confidence, along with useful feedback for technology providers. The sources do not measure learning gains, reduced anxiety, or product improvements from these activities. Festival attendance is not a measure of an AI-produced benefit, and the separate hackathon's civic outcomes remain unspecified.
purpose: Improve understanding of AI through practical use and interactive demonstrations, and obtain user feedback on technology applications.
system: AI tools in the Code For Her workshop and interactive AI applications at the Smart City Experience Centre
deployer: Code For Her, Smart City Consultancy, Milton Keynes City Council, and centre:mk

ratings.reason: Workshop participants and visitors are intended to understand AI better through practical use and interactive demonstrations. The extent of any learning or confidence improvement is unmeasured.
Technology providers are intended to receive useful feedback from public interaction with their applications. The sources do not establish the extent or consequences of that feedback.

ai_role.statement: The program identifies hands-on AI use and construction, while the Experience Centre host identifies interactive AI applications. These provide concrete ways for AI to contribute to learning and feedback, but the sources do not isolate their effects from human instruction and the wider event.

must_hold: Suitable AI tools, practical instruction, usable demonstrations, and a way to collect visitor feedback would be needed. These are inferred requirements, not validated conditions sufficient to reproduce a benefit.

revisions.change: Added the specific intended AI application after reviewing project documentation beyond the collection entry. Benefit depth and outcome status remain separate from the evidence confidence.
